posts.title: AI and Me
posts.description: Lots is being written about AI these days, specifically LLM-based AI. posts.title: An alias analysis shower thought
posts.description: Alias analysis allows a compiler to understand whether two memory accesses may conflict in the sense that they both touch the same memory location and at least one of them is a write. This in turn enables certain compiler optimizations. For example, memory accesses that do not conflict can be rearranged as part of instruction scheduling.
